desc: Derive structural characterization: snowflake = center c + x≥1 middle neighbors + y≥1 leaves per middle; enumeration over (c, y) with caps = deg(v)-1 captures all cases; verified on all 3 samples (1, 0, 3).
Implement the O(N log N) solution: for each candidate center c, sort caps descending, scan to maximize 1 + (1+y)*count; use fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read) for N up to 3×10^5.

Validate implementation: run the three samples, and brute-force compare on small random trees (N≤12, enumerate deletion subsets) to confirm correctness; check edge cases (leaf center, cap-0 neighbors, duplicate caps, path graphs, stars).
